# A function reading a context reads the provider its caller runs under, on
# the interpreter as on the compiled targets (testdata/context_read_in_user_func.txtar).
#
# The interpreter already answered a call made while mounting, since a
# provider pushes onto the scope for the length of its subtree. What it lost
# was everything that runs after the mount: a handler or an effect written
# under `depth(5)` runs once every provider has unwound, and read the default,
# and a provider written *inside* a handler panicked the statement executor,
# which had assumed the lowering would have removed it. Both now run under the
# values they were mounted beneath, and a provider in a handler pushes for the
# statements under it. A named function taken as a value was an error
# ("requires arguments"); it is a value now, bound where it is taken as the
# compiled targets bind it.
#
# setctx.sngl is `t.setContext` as a provider over the rest of a test body:
# the compiled targets pass the value to the calls after it. It used to be
# folded away as a context nothing provides.
#
# The html runs are the same programs in a real Chromium.

sngl test --platform none funcs.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform none setctx.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go setctx.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'


sngl test --platform html funcs.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform html setctx.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- funcs.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

context #depth(1)

func show() => "d{depth}"

func label(x int) => "{x}:{depth}"

func relay() string {
    var s = show()
    return "r" + s
}

func down(n int) string {
    if n <= 0 {
        return "{depth}"
    }
    return down(n - 1)
}

component main node {
    var plain = ""
    var under = ""
    var inner = ""
    var chained = ""
    var recursed = ""
    var method = ""
    var lambda = ""
    var mapped = ""
    var taken = ""
    var clicked = ""
    var direct = ""
    var provided = ""
    func twice() => "{depth * 2}"
    effect(@mount {
        plain = show()
        var f = label
        depth(7) {
            taken = f(2)
        }
    })
    depth(5) {
        effect(@mount {
            under = show()
            chained = relay()
            recursed = down(3)
            method = twice()
            lambda = [0].map(func(x int) => show())[0]
            mapped = [4].map(label)[0]
        })
        depth(9) {
            effect(@mount {
                inner = show()
            })
        }
        button #tap(text="tap", @click {
            clicked = show()
            direct = "{depth}"
        })
    }
    button #wrap(text="wrap", @click {
        depth(7) {
            provided = relay()
        }
    })
    text(value="{clicked} {provided}")
}

func testDefaultWhereNothingProvides(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.plain == "d1")
    t.assert(show() == "d1")
}

func testCallsReadTheirCallersProvider(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.under == "d5")
    t.assert(c.inner == "d9")
    t.assert(c.chained == "rd5")
    t.assert(c.recursed == "5")
    t.assert(c.method == "10")
    t.assert(c.lambda == "d5")
    t.assert(c.mapped == "4:5")
}

func testAFunctionValueIsBoundWhereItIsTaken(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.taken == "2:1")
}

func testAHandlerReadsTheProviderItIsWrittenUnder(t Test, c main) {
    c.tap.click()
    t.assert(c.clicked == "d5")
    t.assert(c.direct == "5")
}

func testAProviderInAHandler(t Test, c main) {
    c.wrap.click()
    t.assert(c.provided == "rd7")
}

window {
    main
}
-- setctx.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

context #theme("light")

func show() => "t:{theme}"

component main node {
    func probe() => show()
    text(value=show())
}

func testSetContextProvidesForWhatFollows(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.probe() == "t:light")
    t.setContext(theme, "dark")
    t.assert(c.probe() == "t:dark")
    t.assert(show() == "t:dark")
}

window {
    main
}
